grades: Grade 8 and up (including the summer before 8th grade)
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteer hours count as community service.
name: Teen Volunteering (Teen Action Group)
what_you_do: Sign up for monthly library volunteer shifts. Staff post the sign-up links each month, and each shift must be logged with the hour form to count.
who_can_apply: East Brunswick residents in or entering 8th grade and up. Use the teen application, not the adult one.
deadline_text: New volunteers are accepted only in June and December. Next window: December (dates within the month not stated).
how_to_apply: Fill out the online teen volunteer application in June or December, wait for the welcome email, join the Remind app, then sign up for shifts. Questions: teens@ebpl.org.
notes: Online application only, no paper forms. The page does not say whether Teen Action Group meetings count as service hours.
